_comment: Where Upkeep updates agent skills from. Only skills already in ~/.claude/skills are managed. Add your own in settings.json under AgentSkillSources, or list whole repos under AgentSkillRepos. type gh: gh skill install/update (repos laid out as skills/*/SKILL.md). type git: a repository folder synced by Upkeep (path "." is the repo root). type graphify: refreshed by graphify's own installer.

_upstreams._comment: Published versions of skills people usually customize. Upkeep never installs these over a skill that has another source; it lists the skill when the upstream folder gets a new commit, so you can merge the change.
